mana.text: Your mana stat is whichever of INT or WIS is higher (wiki Statistics); 106 of 125 wiki Cleric spells cost mana.
mana.label: FACT

wiki_advice: Listed below is the recommended allocation of bonus points by race. Since Wisdom is a Cleric’s main attribute, you should focus on maximizing it whenever possible. Wisdom is directly tied to your healing spells effectiveness and total mana. After that, prioritize Stamina. It gives you extra HP and a bit of stun resistance. Finally, put a point into Dexterity if you have any left. It affects hit rate across the board and increases your proc chance. Dwarf: +2 Stamina and +8 Wisdom Gnome: +2 Stamina and +8 Wisdom Halfling: +4 Stamina, +2 Dexterity, and +4 Wisdom Human: +2 Stamina and +8 Wisdom

build_caveat: Point totals are from the wiki race pages (10 bonus points for every listed race/class). Whether a stat has a per-point cap or diminishing returns at creation is not documented on the wiki: UNVERIFIED.

traits.why: Wise: +5% base WIS and a 15-second +50% WIS burst, your heal and mana stat.

Channeler keeps heals going while you are hit (starts at 10, +25% speed). The wiki Cleric spell list has no school column, so no school trait is suggested from data. Shieldman gives a buckler for off-tanking.
Readiness gives a Cantrip slot from level 1, so one memorized spell survives death. Good insurance for a healer.

Miner starts Mining at 25 with a Trainee's Mining Pick and Pouch, matching the default gathering setup (Mining, Lumberjacking, Smelting) for early coin. Medic (Bind Wound 25 and bandages) is the safer pick if you expect downtime between fights. Blacksmith exists but smithing stays off by default here.

trait_caveat: Trait text and race/class limits are from Template:Traits; picks that your race cannot take are swapped automatically in the race note. Which trait is 'best' is STRATEGY; no sourced numbers compare them.
